about: Typical asks per catalog family (irlpls/catalog.py FAMILIES), used for 'Where it ranks' on provider-published card pages and in check.html. Asks are taken verbatim from tests/test_match_bench.py; a family with no bench ask uses its catalog example_needs (marked source: catalog). Labels are short names for the ask, nothing more. Ranks are computed by irlpls.match.rank (and IRLMatch in the browser) against the listed cards; nothing here is a result.
